partners.diseaseBName: bronchiectasis with or without elevated sweat chloride 2

partners.mechanism_chain: OSTM1 (HGNC:23541) —DISRUPTS→ Skeletal calcium homeostasis (GO:0005304); Skeletal calcium homeostasis (GO:0005304) —LEADS_TO→ Osteopetrosis (HP:0000964); RYR1 (HGNC:10252) —DISRUPTS→ Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium release (GO:0016474); Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium release (GO:0016474) —LEADS_TO→ Malignant Hyperthermia (HP:0003198); Skeletal calcium homeostasis (GO:0005304) —BINDS→ RYR1 (HGNC:10252). **Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-2672351)

**Proposed mechanism:** CASQ2 (HGNC:2029) —DISRUPTS→ Osteoclast differentiation and function (GO:0002137); Osteoclast differentiation and function (GO:0002137) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal osteoclast number (HP:0004502); CASQ2 (HGNC:2029) —DISRUPTS→ Cardiac calcium release and reuptake (GO:0003011); Cardiac calcium release and reuptake (GO:0003011) —LEADS_TO→ Ventricular arrhythmia (HP:0011677). **How to falsify it:** Absence of CASQ2 mutations in patients with both osteopetrosis and catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia, or identification of distinct causative genes for each disease with no overlap in cellular function. _(variant: rs121908254)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of CASQ2 in calcium homeostasis could lead to novel therapeutic strategies targeting calcium handling for both bone disorders and cardiac arrhythmias.

The convergence lies in the shared cellular processes affected by these distinct genes, impacting tissue homeostasis.

**How to falsify it:** If genetic studies reveal that the causal variants for autosomal recessive osteopetrosis 5 and hereditary sensory and autonomic neuropathy type 2A do not affect common downstream pathways or cellular functions, or if distinct molecular mechanisms are identified that are not reconcilable with a shared disease module, this hypothesis would be falsified. _(variant: N/A)_
